title: One Hive pin (v2)
description: An immutable reference to a commit in a registered repository, optionally narrowed to a file or directory in it. The commit is what the pin certifies; a path, when present, is what the referring event is about and is binding for consumers. Strict consumers MUST reject unknown fields.

repository.description: Stable repository id resolved through the repository registry.

commit_oid.description: Algorithm-prefixed full commit OID. Never abbreviated, never a ref.

path.description: NFC, repository-relative POSIX path to a regular file or a directory; no leading '/', no '.'/'..'/empty component, no NUL/CR/LF/backslash. Absent: the whole commit.
